name: OmaPkDex
author: HeitorM50
description: A creature in your bar that hatches and evolves as you burn AI coding tokens, reading the usage records omarchy.agents already collects

barWidget.description: Animated sprite that evolves with your AI token usage, with a Pokédex, a per-individual profile (level, nature, ability, IVs, stats, moves), a catch log, Rare Candy from filled rate limits, and a token shop.

schema.label: Growth difficulty
schema.description: Multiplies evolution thresholds. Below 1 grows faster. Changing it rescales the progress you already banked, so nothing evolves or graduates for free. The 0.3 default is tuned for ~50M tokens/day; use 1.0 for the original PokeTokenBar balance (~253M/day).

schema.label: Shop prices
schema.description: Multiplies shop prices, independent of growth difficulty. Below 1 is cheaper. Both have sliders in the Settings tab.

schema.label: Show today's tokens next to the sprite
Count usage already recorded
schema.description: By default counting starts at zero, so the first creature does not graduate instantly. Turn on to let your existing lifetime total count toward progress.

schema.label: Re-check interval (seconds)
schema.description: Safety net: the usage records are watched by FileView and react immediately. This timer only covers a write that produces no file event.

schema.label: Species pinned to the bar
schema.description: Pokédex number of the species to show in the bar, independent of the companion you are raising. 0 follows the companion. Easier from the star on a Pokédex cell.
